sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: ONE-GO Gq BRET assay performed; receptor is functional in Gq signaling with the N-terminal Flag tag present.
sites.rationale: B2R is a GPCR with its N-terminus extracellular (topology landmarks: EXTRACELLULAR 1–61, TM1 begins at residue 62). The canonical sequence carries no endogenous signal peptide (raw topology is all-O from residue 1). The construct uses an exogenous HA signal peptide to drive membrane insertion; after SP cleavage the Flag tag sits at the extracellular N-terminus, before Met1 of B2R (insert_after_residue = 0, residue_after = M). No specific junction residue is named in the paper, but exactly one extracellular terminus exists, so the position is topology_derived. The 61-residue extracellular N-terminal domain provides ample steric room for a short epitope tag. Full-length human B2R (residues 1–391) cloned into pcDNA3.1(+) with an N-terminal Flag tag placed after an exogenous HA signal peptide; construct used in ONE-GO Gq BRET assay in transfected cells.

sources.claim: For both the wild-type B1R and B2R constructs used in ONE-GO Gq BRET assay, a full-length human receptor gene (residues 1–353 for B1R or residues 1–391 for B2R) was cloned into a pcDNA3.1(+) vector with an N-terminal Flag tag after an HA signal peptide.

literature_notes: L1 (AltB2R-HA): The HA tag is on AltB2R, an alternative protein encoded within the B2R locus but distinct from B2R itself; it does not constitute a tag on B2R's extracellular face and was excluded. L2 (B2R-Flag) and L5/L6 (B2R-CFP): both tags are at the intracellular C-terminus (residue 391, topology INTRACELLULAR 336–391) and are recorded in other_positions. L3 confirms surface display of B2R-Flag but does not change the intracellular nature of that tag. No ledger line reports a tag inserted into any of the four extracellular loops (ECL1 116–132, ECL2 198–221, ECL3 293–311) of B2R, so no internal loop sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: B2R C-terminal Flag tag (B2R-Flag / B2R(HA)Flag); residue 391 (Q) lies within the intracellular C-terminal tail (topology 336–391).
B2R-CFP fusion at C-terminus; receptor traffics to plasma membrane (confirmed by Lyn-GFP colocalization in L6) but the CFP tag itself is intracellular.
